entities.name: Silas Duskmoor
entities.description: An extroverted fighter whose presence and combat style evoke a beast-like intensity that serves as an ancestral threat to dragons.
entities.quote: Silas Duskmoor Extroverted Authority | Expressive Violence Public-facing presence Silas occupies space. He laughs loud, speaks freely, mocks openly.

entities.name: Agnus
entities.description: An introverted and minimalist combatant whose silent, unpredictable nature makes him an environmental threat to demons.
entities.quote: Agnus Introverted Authority | Economized Violence Silence as control Agnus doesn’t fill rooms. He empties them.

entities.name: Tedmond Duskmoor
entities.description: A past member of the Duskmoor bloodline who established the family's legacy as dragon hunters.
entities.quote: Tedmond Duskmoor proved dragons can be killed, hunted, and driven back.

entities.name: Duskmoor
entities.description: A bloodline historically feared by dragons due to their demonstrated ability to hunt and kill the species.
entities.quote: Duskmoors are not myth to dragons — they are historical executioners.

timeline_events.title: Establishment of Duskmoor Dragon Hunting
timeline_events.description: Tedmond Duskmoor solidified the bloodline's reputation by demonstrating that dragons were mortal and could be driven back.
timeline_events.quote: Tedmond Duskmoor proved dragons can be killed, hunted, and driven back. Silas carries that lineage visibly in presence, combat style, and aura.
